```{r}
df <- bfd_depart_final
table(df$clusters)
```

```{r}
analise.numericas <- df %>% group_by(clusters) %>% 
  summarise(mean_delay_depart = mean(delay_depart),
            mean_depart_air_temperature = mean(depart_air_temperature),
            mean_depart_dew_point = mean(depart_dew_point),
            mean_depart_relative_humidity = mean(depart_relative_humidity),
            mean_depart_wind_direction = mean(depart_wind_direction),
            mean_depart_pressure = mean(depart_pressure),
            mean_depart_visibility = mean(depart_visibility),
            mean_depart_apparent_temperature = mean(depart_apparent_temperature),
            )
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(clusters), y = delay_depart, fill = as.factor(clusters))) +
```

```{r}
# install.packages("scales")
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("ricardo-bion/ggradar")

library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(ggradar)

analise_medias <- df %>%
  group_by(clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    Atraso_Partida = mean(delay_depart, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temperatura = mean(depart_air_temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    Umidade_Relativa = mean(depart_relative_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Direcao_Vento = mean(depart_wind_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pressao = mean(depart_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    Visibilidade = mean(depart_visibility, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

medias_normalizadas <- analise_medias %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-clusters), rescale)

ggradar(medias_normalizadas,
        grid.min = 0, grid.mid = 0.5, grid.max = 1,
        axis.label.size = 4,
        legend.title = "Clusters",
        legend.text.size = 10) +
  labs(title = "Perfil dos Clusters de Voo") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
table(df[df$clusters == 1,]$company)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

df_numerico <- df %>%
  select(delay_depart, depart_air_temperature, depart_dew_point,
         depart_relative_humidity, depart_wind_direction, depart_pressure,
         depart_visibility, depart_apparent_temperature) %>%
  na.omit()

pca_resultado <- prcomp(df_numerico, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_resultado)

df_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_resultado$x[, 1:2]) 

df_pca$clusters <- df %>% pull(clusters)

ggplot(df_pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = as.factor(clusters))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
  labs(title = "Visualização dos Clusters via PCA",
       x = "Componente Principal 1",
       y = "Componente Principal 2",
       color = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
